gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all permission schemes available in the Jira Cloud platform so that I can review and manage access controls for my projects.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of all permission schemes with their details.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to create a new permission scheme to define specific permissions for a new project I am setting up.
gold.ideal: Creates a new permission scheme and returns the details of the created scheme.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to delete an existing permission scheme that is no longer needed to keep the system organized.
gold.ideal: Successfully deletes the specified permission scheme.

gold.user: As a project lead, I want to get the details of a specific permission scheme to understand the permissions assigned to it.
gold.ideal: Returns the details of the specified permission scheme.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to update an existing permission scheme to modify the permissions as per the new project requirements.
gold.ideal: Updates the specified permission scheme and returns the updated details.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all permission grants associated with a specific permission scheme to ensure the correct access is given.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of all permission grants for the specified permission scheme.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to add a new permission grant to a permission scheme to allow specific users to perform certain actions.
gold.ideal: Creates a new permission grant and returns the details of the created grant.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to remove a specific permission grant from a permission scheme to revoke access from certain users.
gold.ideal: Successfully deletes the specified permission grant from the permission scheme.

gold.user: As a project lead, I want to view the details of a specific permission grant to verify the permissions assigned to users.
gold.ideal: Returns the details of the specified permission grant.
